title: TransportOperationReceiptDocument
description: Server-owned idempotency receipt for offline-replayed transport mutations. An exact retry returns the original result; a conflicting reuse of the client operation id fails closed. Kept as its own collection (L8 decision, 18 Nov 2026): it is a revision fence other commands read, and resumable manifest-import progress.

requestHash.description: Stable hash of the mutation payload; a same-id different-payload replay is rejected.

resultRevision.description: Committed entity revision returned to a replayed caller.

expiresAt.description: Receipt retention horizon for cleanup sweeps.

resultJson.description: Serialized operation response for exact replay of compound results (e.g. manifest import summaries). Null for scalar-result operations.

completedRows.description: For manifestImport only: number of input rows already resolved. With completedRowIndices, rows may finish out of order so a whole travel party fits one transaction; older partial receipts use a contiguous input prefix.

importedGuestIds.description: Guests already applied by a resumable manifest import; prevents two source rows updating one person across chunks.

completedRowIndices.description: For manifestImport only: original input indices atomically resolved with their complete travel party. Includes explicitly rejected rows; its length equals completedRows.
